bioanalytical_quote: the residual concentrations of the enzymes in plasma were measured using ELISA
notes: Both PEPlife2 values verified exactly: lysostaphin 1.5 ± 0.7 h and Lst-HDD 3.1 ± 0.6 h (p = 0.01). IMPORTANT CONTEXT THAT THE RECORD LOSES: the paper states the elimination is biphasic and that ~95% of BOTH proteins had already been cleared by the first sampling point, 25 minutes after injection - only 2.8 and 1.6 μg/mL remained of a theoretical ~50 μg/mL. These terminal half-lives therefore describe the slow tail of a curve that has already lost almost the whole dose, and are not comparable with a single-phase half-life from a study sampled earlier. The AUC difference is only 2.6-fold, far less than the 10-fold the authors had seen for a covalently dimerised comparator. Note lysostaphin's PEPlife2 sequence carries a C-terminal His6 purification tag, which is part of the dosed material here but is an artefact of expression rather than a designed half-life feature. The body gives no strain, sex or group size.
